targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_MECH-063-777-779-cluster_2026-07-18. The self-route control_axes_collinear_toward_one_scalar is an artifact and does not weaken MECH-063. C1 failed on seed-count (3/5 vs min 4) and dispersion, NOT on collinearity: mean_sin_angle 0.530 exceeds the 0.500 margin. The score axis's dependent variable (D_action_mass) was saturated at ceiling on seeds 11/29/37 (0.94-0.9997) and at floor on seed 23 (0.002-0.013), leaving no headroom for the axis to express itself; dD_score tracks D-headroom (largest, 0.054, on seed 17, the only mid-range seed). The P0 readiness gate passed because R5 axis_authority aggregates norm_v_score by MEAN across seeds (0.1046 > 0.05 floor) while seeds 23 (0.0423) and 29 (0.0346) were individually below floor, and because the design guards saturation on the temperature axis's readout (E_SAT_CEIL) with no equivalent guard on the score axis's. Compounding this, 3 of 5 seeds ran at 2-30% of the 900-step budget (untrained agent, hazard-terminating env), putting the worst cell exactly at MIN_SELECTS=20. The queueing session's seed-11 inline PASS (sin_angle 0.93) is not contradicted: identical script (single commit 3b270a1) and identical substrate (no ree_core commit in the window), with the temperature axis reproducing (+0.30 inline vs dE_temp 0.323 cloud) and only the score axis diverging, because cloud seed 11 was saturated at D=0.997. The verdict is knife-edge on per-seed saturation regime, which is machine-class sensitive. MECH-063 was not tested. Retest V3-EXQ-777a with sample-driven stopping, a D-saturation guard, and per-seed authority gating.

targets.fanout_exempt_reason: GOV-FANOUT-1 exempt: the bottleneck routes to a single unambiguous build (sample-driven stopping + per-seed gating + DV saturation guard), not to a discrimination among >=2 live hypotheses.
learning_extracted: Episode-denominated sampling budgets do not control sample size for untrained agents in terminating environments -- yield varied 40x across one seed set.
Guard saturation on every axis's dependent variable, not just the first; a std>0.0 check is a non-degeneracy test, not a saturation test.
Never aggregate a per-seed readiness gate by the mean -- R5's fmean defeated the very false-collapse trap it was built to catch.
A single-seed inline pre-queue check is invalid validation for a metric with seed-dependent saturation.
Cross-machine-class reproducibility is readout-specific: the temperature axis reproduced darwin-arm64 -> linux-x86_64, the score axis did not.
Recording discipline paid off -- per-cell n_env_steps is what made this diagnosable without a re-run. This is a design gap, NOT a recording gap.
An auto-derived evidence_direction can move a claim's confidence before a human adjudicates the self-route; the governance cycle's defer-not-demote decision is what preserved MECH-063.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_MECH-063-777-779-cluster_2026-07-18. Direction non_contributory is correct, but the self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue mislabels the cause: SD-069 is ready and working, and the failure is sample starvation. The arms DID set the sharp source (config.phasic_burst.signal_source = 'instantaneous_pe'; script line 205), and bursts fired in every PHASIC-ON cell (burst_level_max 1.0; n_event_ticks 5-22). The failed precondition phasic_fires_real_events (measured 5, threshold 10) is a MIN across cells sourced entirely from seed 23 / T1P1, the cell that ran 19 env steps of a 900-step budget; sample_sufficiency (19 vs 20) has the same origin. Seeds 11/17/23 ran at 2-28% of budget while 29/37 ran at 100% -- a seed-dependent early-termination pattern reproduced almost exactly in V3-EXQ-777, i.e. a property of the untrained agent in a hazard-terminating env rather than of this probe. mean_dR_phasic (-0.083) is computed over ~5 event ticks and carries no weight. MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) was not tested. Retest V3-EXQ-779a with sample-driven stopping guaranteeing MIN_EVENT_TICKS per PHASIC-ON cell, and a sample_starvation_requeue label distinct from substrate-capability failure.

learning_extracted: Self-route vocabulary must distinguish 'substrate cannot' from 'we did not sample enough' -- substrate_not_ready_requeue sent readers hunting a missing SD-069 capability that was present and firing.
Min-across-cells readiness gates must report WHICH cell failed and why, or a single dead seed silently vetoes a working run.

A ratio-based event trigger (trigger_ratio 1.2 against a surprise EMA) may need an absolute-level companion under background_drift_enabled, where chronic drift elevates the EMA baseline and desensitises a purely relative trigger.

cluster_pattern.shape: Both runs' load-bearing criterion was decided by sampling noise, not by the mechanism under test. In both, ALL substrate-capability preconditions passed (regulators live and firing) while the discrimination criterion failed at exactly 3/5 seeds against a min_seeds=4 bar.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The shared 2x2 read-only telemetry-probe template fixes its sampling budget in EPISODES, while its readiness gates and criterion bars are denominated in SELECTIONS / EVENT TICKS / PER-SEED COUNTS. Because these probes run an UNTRAINED agent in a HAZARD-TERMINATING environment, episodes terminate early and seed-dependently -- a 40x spread in yield across one seed set (2% to 100% of budget), reproduced near-identically across two structurally different experiments with different env configs and different regulators. The budget therefore does not determine the sample, and the min_seeds=4-of-5 bar becomes unreachable whenever 3 of 5 seeds run short, regardless of the hypothesis's truth value.
cluster_pattern.opposite_gate_failures: 777's P0 was too PERMISSIVE (mean-across-seeds axis authority let through a run whose score axis was individually dead on 2 seeds and saturated on 2 more); 779's P0 was too RESTRICTIVE on the wrong axis (min-across-cells let a single 19-step cell veto a run whose substrate worked everywhere else). Neither guarded the actual binding constraint: sample yield per cell.

changes: Sample-driven stopping: run until every cell reaches >= MIN_SELECTS fresh E3 selections (auto-reset and continue across episodes), replacing the fixed 3x300 budget; cap total env steps to bound runtime and RECORD realised step and episode counts per cell.

Add a saturation guard on the score axis's DV: D_SAT_LOW / D_SAT_HIGH on D_action_mass_mean, mirroring the existing E_SAT_CEIL on entropy. A seed whose D is pinned must be reported non-informative for the score axis rather than contributing an angle.
Per-seed R5 authority gating: replace fmean([norm_v_score]) > EFFECT_FLOOR with a per-seed test; report which seeds pass.
Re-examine whether min_seeds = 4 of 5 is the right bar once yield is equalised; record per-seed saturation state alongside sin_angle.
Same sample-driven stopping; guarantee MIN_EVENT_TICKS per PHASIC-ON cell before scoring.

Emit sample_starvation_requeue (not substrate_not_ready_requeue) when the unmet precondition is a sample count rather than a capability check, and report the offending cell (seed + arm) in the precondition record.
Consider an absolute-level companion to the ratio-based burst trigger under background_drift_enabled; record burst_level_mean against the surprise EMA so this is checkable.
